1.w: And He entered into the synagogue again, and a man having a withered hand was there.

2.w: And they were watching Him, whether He will heal him on the Sabbaths, so that they might accuse Him.

3.w: And He says to the man having the withered hand, “Arise into the midst.”

4.w: And He says to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbaths to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?” But they were silent.

5.w: And having looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardness of their heart, He says to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” And he stretched [it] out, and his hand was restored.

6.w: And the Pharisees, having gone out, immediately were taking counsel with the Herodians against Him, how they might destroy Him.

7.w: And Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, and a great multitude from Galilee followed, and from Judea,

8.w: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and beyond the Jordan, and around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, having heard how much He was doing, came to Him.

9.w: And He spoke to His disciples so that a boat may wait on Him because of the crowd, so that they might not press upon Him.

10.w: For He healed many, so as for as many as had afflictions to fall upon Him so that they might touch Him.

11.w: And the unclean spirits, when they were seeing Him, were falling down before Him and crying out, saying, “You are the Son of God!”

12.w: And He was warning them much that they should not make Him known.

13.w: And He goes up onto the mountain, and He summons those whom He Himself was wanting, and they went away to Him.

14.w: And He appointed twelve, whom also He named apostles, that they might be with Him and that He might send them to preach

15.w: and to have authority to cast out demons.

16.w: And He appointed the Twelve: And to Simon He added the name Peter,

17.w: and James the [son] of Zebedee and John the brother of James, and He added to them the name Boanerges, which is Sons of Thunder,

18.w: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the [son] of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Cananean,

19.w: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.

20.w: And He comes to a house and a crowd comes together again, so that not even are they able to eat bread.

21.w: And having heard, those belonging to Him went out to seize Him; for they were saying that He was out of His mind.

22.w: And the scribes, those from Jerusalem, having come down, were saying, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the ruler of the demons He casts out the demons.”

23.w: And having summoned them, He was saying to them in parables, “How is Satan able to cast out Satan?

24.w: And if a kingdom may be divided against itself, that kingdom is not able to stand.

25.w: And if a house may be divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.

26.w: And if Satan rose up against himself and was divided, he is not able to stand, but he has an end.

27.w: But no one is able, having entered into the house of the strong [man], to plunder his goods, unless first he should bind the strong [man]. And then he will plunder his house.

28.w: Truly I say to you⁺ that all sins and blasphemies will be forgiven the sons of men, as many as they may blaspheme.

29.w: But whoever may blaspheme in regard to the Holy Spirit does not have forgiveness to the age, but is guilty [of] eternal sin.”

30.w: For they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.”

31.w: And His mother and His brothers come, and standing outside, they sent to Him, calling Him.

32.w: And a crowd was sitting around Him, and they say to Him, “Behold, Your mother and Your brothers outside seek You.”

33.w: And answering them, He says, “Who are My mother and My brothers?”

34.w: And having looked around at those sitting around Him in a circle, He says, “Behold, My mother and My brothers!

35.w: For whoever shall do the will of God, this is My brother and sister and mother.”
